states: Private mock stack (backend + Vite on 7735/5253) built from main plus this change; before captures taken on the same stack before the edit, and the 1440 behaviour re-checked with main's versions of these files swapped back in
Before, bars mode at 1600 dark: hovering artifact-cache-310 swapped CPU, memory and disk for synchronized sparklines while Net I/O and Disk I/O stayed as static numbers

After, bars mode at 1600 dark and 1920 light: the same hover swaps all five cells; the I/O cells show both series with a compact coloured pair (e.g. ↓3.2M ↑2.2M, R1.4M W826K) and the svg labels carry the full rates; row stays 32px tall
After, pointer scrub on the CPU chart moves one cursor across all five charts, including both I/O charts

After, live update while scrubbing: with the Net I/O tooltip open on artifact-cache-310, a websocket snapshot changed the compact pair (↓2.8M to ↓3.7M) while all five chart nodes stayed mounted and the tooltip stayed open (before this change every live update remounted the lens charts)

After, idle I/O (history intercepted to 1-6 KB/s with one 80 KB/s disk write flush): both I/O lines sit within a pixel of the axis and the flush still shows as a bump instead of every blip filling the cell
After, Trends (sparklines) mode at 1600 dark: every running guest's I/O cell shows chart plus compact pair (736 charts, 256 rate pairs, 0 clipped), stopped dev-portal-312 keeps its dash
After, 768 dark and light: I/O columns are hidden by the layout as before; the lens and Trends still render CPU/memory/disk with 0 clipped cells
Pre-existing, not changed here: at 1440 the first-use history hint wraps and its dismissal shifts the table 36px, so the first lens opens on the next row (same on main)
